Replied in #coastal-team, in the thread under your message.

The latest figure posted there is 10%. On Nov 17, 2025, Bettina first wrote 12%, then a few minutes later retracted it ("please ignore my earlier note, it's 10%"), saying she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark.

I can't confirm from the channel that 10% is the signed term, so check it with June Osei-Lark (deal desk) before the renewal brief goes out.
